headline: American Express Chief Legal Officer Laureen Seeger Sells $22.9M in Stock
summary: American Express chief legal officer Laureen Seeger sold company stock valued at $22.9 million.
why: Insider transactions at major financial institutions like American Express are closely monitored by investors for signals regarding executive sentiment on the company's valuation.

impacts.name: American Express
impacts.why: Large insider sales can sometimes create downward pressure on the stock.
